The heat pump is the default call for heat unless the outdoor ambient temperature is less than 0F or the unit is still actively trying to defrost the coil when a heat demand is invoked.  Demand is invoked when the room temperature drops below 1F from the heat set point.  Demand is dropped when the temperature reaches 1F above set point.  If for whatever reason the heat pump is not providing adequate heat (e.g. need to defrost, not increasing room temperature) the resistance heat will engage for a single satisfaction of heat demand.  Following this case, heat pump will then continue to be the primary first call for heat.
